items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: I know Black Ben didn't come out of Jones' home.

ctx.x: Well, I think he was pretty good, you know, doing well at it.

Now, he know all them fellas down there. They been down there. They been down there. They come out Jones' home out there. Like Lewis Armstrong. They all come out there. Renny come out there. Joe come out there. Lewis come out there. Shots too, huh? I know Black Ben didn't come out of Jones' home. I believe he did. A whole bunch of them come out.
